notes.title: Sorcery Jokers — Now 65% OFF for One Week!
notes.content: [p]Step into a world forever changed by the sudden emergence of magic.[/p][p]In Sorcery Jokers, magic is no longer hidden—it’s everywhere. Governments scramble to regulate it, while others fight for the freedom to wield it as they please. This modern-fantasy visual novel plunges you into fast-paced battles, political intrigue, and deeply personal stories from six unique perspectives.[/p][p]Whether you’re a fan of immersive storytelling, anime-style art, or strategic action, Sorcery Jokers offers a unique blend of all three.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/703730/Sorcery_Jokers_All_Ages_Version/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Don’t miss out! Get Sorcery Jokers now, while it's on sale for 65% OFF! [/p][p]The magic—and the fight—await.[/p]
